messages:
maria: Quick PSA ahead of tomorrow's release — can folks keep changelog entries short bullets with three things: impact, migration/rollback steps (if any), and owner. Example below. Please add component tags like [runtime], [api], etc. Helps the release notes editor. :rocket:

ajay: sgtm — do we want severity labels (patch/minor/major) too?

maria: yes, add a single tag (patch/minor/major). If it's unclear, mark 'minor' and we'll confirm in review.

sarah: here's an example entry I used last time:

```text
- [api][minor] Add `retry_on_429` to inference client
  - impact: reduces 429 errors for high-concurrency customers
  - migration: client auto-opts in, no config change needed
  - owner: sarah
```

leo: what's the cutoff for adding entries? branch bumps?

maria: cutoff is 09:00 UTC tomorrow for new entries; version bump (semver) must be on a separate PR with the changelog link in the description. If you need a late add, ping me + @release-bot and include a short justification.

release-bot: Reminder: CHANGELOG cutoff in 14h 52m — please finalise entries. <https://redwood-internal/release-checklist|release checklist>

ajay: will do. also, small ask — please keep each entry to 2-4 bullet lines; the editor trims verbose paragraphs. :eyes:

maria: thanks — appreciate the help keeping notes consumable. I'll sweep entries at cutoff and tidy tags as needed. Ping me in thread for last-minute clarifications.
